g.text: in client/src/screens grouped by role. Every one carries
the four §11.4 sub-states — loading, empty, error, stale
— as a single LoadState value rather than four booleans,
so an impossible combination cannot be represented.
Each gateway converts one external protocol
into the interface the control layer expects. Three things
follow: 10.4.6 rate limiting and retry live in one place
(HttpClient); a control class can be unit-tested against a
fake gateway, which 10.6.3 requires; and the two sources
still unverified — the NEA feed's update frequency and
OneMap Search — are each isolated behind one class, so a
before touching a control class. 2.3.6 and 10.3.3 require
enforcement on the server, and putting the call in the
abstract base is how the design makes forgetting it
